_about: Shared test vectors for the de-identification cleaner. The Python reference (app/deid.py) and the Android Kotlin port MUST both pass every vector. 'must_redact' lists the tag types that must appear in the cleaned text and the literal substrings that must NOT survive. 'must_keep' vectors must come back byte-identical. Add a vector for every false positive or miss found in beta; never delete one without clinician-safety sign-off.
